title: Find out which shell is running now
summary: Print the name of the shell that runs in this terminal window. The command only reads information and changes nothing.

aliases.text: what shell is running in terminal
how to see my terminal shell
как узнать какой shell я использую

steps.explain: Ask ps for the program name of the process whose ID is $$, which is the shell running this terminal. Read-only.
steps.expect: The shell name, for example bash or zsh. On macOS it can start with a dash, such as -zsh, or show a full path such as /bin/zsh.

source.title: ps manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
